_about: The brand's look, in one place. Every visual the engine makes reads this file: the story deck, the control page and the motion cards. Change the brand's look here and nowhere else.
_source: Placeholder: replace with your brand's colours, typeface, corner radius and logo (an inline SVG for light and for dark backgrounds), taken from your website or brand guide.
name: Acme

shape._ui_radius: The control page and the story deck: rounded and soft (owner, 2026-11-07: 'why so boxy'). radius stays the brand's rule for what it publishes.

palette._about: The solid colours the control page and the story deck paint with, beside the neutrals in colors (white, the greys, the ink). Owner's palette, 2026-11-07: 'use solid colors across and from this palette', 'keep grey/white as well'. Pages, themes and the deck's beats take a colour by position, so a colour follows its page or theme; roles name what critical, warning, good, action and info look like. Motion cards for posts keep colors (the brand's own). Shown pastel (owner, 2026-11-07): a soft fill of each colour with a deep shade of it for the text; set style to solid for full-strength fills.
